title: Rotate the Loop: Blockwise Conformality for Looped Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2610.14030v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Looped transformers reuse one shared block across many recurrent steps, so depth becomes a quantity that can be spent at runtime rather than a stack of distinct layers. Those extra steps help only if a write made on one recurrent step is still readable on later ones, and that depends on the linear map applied to the residual between recurrent steps. We show that whether the loop learns to track state is a geometric question about the form of this map, and we propose blockwise conformal injections: the residual splits into coordinate-aligned groups and rotates inside each one, so every group has its own timescale while the geometry stays exact within it. Our experiments show a performance increase on a demanding form of state tracking - last-token accuracy when the rest of the prefix is already correct - and on language modelling, where a signal written earlier has to be retrieved at the end of the sequence.

translated_title: 旋转循环：面向循环Transformer的分块共形性
translated_abstract: 循环Transformer在多个递归步骤中复用同一个共享模块，因此深度变成了一种可以在运行时“支出”的资源，而不是一堆各不相同的层的堆叠。只有当某个递归步骤上写入的信息在后续步骤中仍然可读时，这些额外的步骤才会有所帮助，而这取决于递归步骤之间应用于残差的线性映射。我们证明，循环是否学会追踪状态是关于该映射形式的几何问题，并提出了分块共形注入：将残差分割为坐标对齐的分组，并在每个分组内部进行旋转，使得每个分组拥有自己的时间尺度，同时其内部的几何结构保持精确。我们的实验在最严苛的状态追踪形式上——即在前缀其余部分已经正确时最后一个token的准确率——以及在语言建模任务上（其中较早写入的信号需要在序列末尾被检索出来）都展示了性能提升。
tldr: 提出分块共形注入方法，将循环Transformer的残差分割为坐标对齐的分组并在组内旋转，使每个分组拥有独立的时间尺度，从而提升状态追踪和语言建模性能。
en_tdlr: Proposes blockwise conformal injections that split the residual into coordinate-aligned groups rotating within each, giving every group its own timescale, thereby improving state tracking and language modeling in looped transformers.
